admission.justification: The six member obligations together promise the leaf's seats run their loop directly with exact objects, own bookkeeping and own recovery while the Manager keeps only its named occasions; no single member states that joint guarantee.

guarantee: A leaf's seats — Worker, Reviewer and Curator on ordinary leaves, or Consolidator and Reviewer on consolidation leaves — run the leaf's work directly between their seats: each hands the exact freeze, sealed verdict, producer list, memory candidate or code concern directly, each seat keeps its own ordinary bookkeeping lane and its own pending-and-retry discipline, and the Manager receives only its named occasions and relays none of a hand-over's contents.
title: The leaf's seats run their loop directly
